narrative.overview: OPS365 sells continuity: an operation that keeps moving while other people's problems don't. The system reads like a well-run site office, not a startup pitch deck — a fixed navy structure you can always find your way back to (the sidebar, the footer, the WhatsApp line), numbered sequences that mean something (the six-step cycle is a real process, not decoration), and exactly one loud color used sparingly enough that it still means "pay attention here" every time it appears. The system was built, then deliberately stripped of a first pass that read as generic AI output: small "eyebrow" labels above every heading, identical icon-card grids, and a colored side-border on callout boxes were all present at one point and removed on sight once recognized. None of the three come back.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, bordered, high-contrast — no shadows, no gradients, no blur.
One navy-deep 'peak' band per page carries the single boldest claim; every other section stays on white.
Numbers are earned, not decorative: they appear only where a real sequence exists, never as a 01/02/03 label on an arbitrary list.
WhatsApp green is the one color from outside the palette, used only for the WhatsApp affordance itself.

rules.name: The One Peak Rule
rules.body: Each page gets exactly one navy-deep 'peak' band holding its single boldest claim. A page with zero peaks reads flat; a page with two or more has no climax.

rules.name: The Earned Number Rule
rules.body: A number is only ever shown where it reflects a real, meaningful sequence. It is never used to label an arbitrary list of features or cards.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase label ever sits above a heading to announce what the heading is about. The heading carries its own weight at full display size.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadows, no blur, no glassmorphism anywhere. Depth comes from a navy-deep fill or a 2px border only.

rules.name: The No-Side-Tab Rule
rules.body: A callout or note never gets a thick colored border on one side. Callouts get a flat gray background and nothing else.

dos: Do keep exactly one .band-dark peak per page.
Do keep the mobile WhatsApp/Contacto action bar fixed and visible on every page.
Do use the Step Row pattern for any future real sequence.
Do keep buttons' hover lift as the only shared micro-interaction.
donts: Don't put a small uppercase 'eyebrow' label above any heading.
Don't give a card, list item, or callout a colored border-left/border-right.
Don't add a drop shadow anywhere.
Don't add numbers to a list unless the order itself carries real information.
Don't invent a testimonial, statistic, client logo, or case study to fill a section.
